curve_sampling_note: Live candidate checkpoints evaluated every 1000 steps (1..=10000); final Q8_0 model reflects selected_best_checkpoint at step 6250
step0_net2wider_note: At step 0 gamma_net2wider=0.0 so Shell-1 768D preserves Shell-0 384D bit-identically; init_val_nats_768_ungated_gamma1 records distinct random Shell-1 loss when gamma=1.0
phase_a_non_monotonic_rise_explanation: During Phase A (steps 1..=6000, gamma_net2wider=0.0, freeze_shell0=false), each step applies single-position AdamW updates (batch_size=4, pos = 2 + ((step*3 + b_i*7) % span)) across 16384-vocab Shell-0 tables (u0_table, bias0_vocab, stiefel_p0, and 12-layer 0..384 slices) over 795 training documents (~30 epochs) while cosine LR decays 0.000180->0.000025 after warmup_a=150. Validation is sampled every phase_a_eval_stride=500 steps on 32 held-out docs (192 tokens), whereas the CSV logs every checkpoint_stride=1000 steps; after reaching the Phase-A minimum on the 500-step eval grid (best_s0_model, quantized to Q8_0 4.003477 nats / 0.100494 BPB), continued single-position updates overfit the 795-doc train slices relative to the 192-token val split, driving the 1000-step live trajectory upward from 4.125448 (step 2000) to 4.204127 (3000), 4.732547 (4000), 4.966652 (5000), and 5.102107 nats / 0.128072 BPB (step 6000).
shell0_step6000_freeze_mechanism: At step == phase_a_steps (6000), v72_1_train_with_steps restores best_s0_model, quantizes and locks model.u0_table via v72_1_quantize_q8_0_rows (Q8_0 + 8D Walsh-Hadamard), sets gamma_net2wider=0.65_f32, re-seeds u_delta1_table / zeros bias_delta1_vocab, and zeros all Phase-B AdamW moment buffers. For steps 6001..=10000 (in_phase_b=true), forward_and_backward_step_ex takes the freeze_shell0=true branch (skip_low_384=true in layer_backward_768_state, skipping 0..384 and cross_shell_mix_384) and the Phase-B AdamW block updates only bias_delta1_vocab, u_delta1_table, stiefel_p1, and layer slices 384..768. Because compute_logits_shell0_16k reads exclusively Shell-0 parameters (0..384), val_nats_384d=4.003477 and val_bpb_384d=0.100494 remain bit-identically frozen across every Phase-B row (7000, 8000, 9000, 10000, 6250).
phase_b_non_monotonic_rise_explanation: At Phase-B entry (step 6001), warmup_b=100 ramps LR 0.000030->0.000160 while near-zero Delta-Shell-1 residuals (u_delta1_table 16384x48, bias_delta1_vocab 16384) adapt on top of frozen Shell-0. At the first phase_b_eval_stride=250 checkpoint (step 6250, lr=0.000159), the Q8_0-quantized cand_model achieves its minimum val_nats_768d=3.979073 (0.099882 BPB, PPL 53.467460) and is captured in best_s1_model. Beyond step 6250, 3750 additional single-position batch_size=4 updates on the 16384-vocab Delta-Shell-1 head overfit the 795-doc train slices against the 192-token val split, raising live val_nats_768d to 4.338859 (7000), 4.462409 (8000), 5.018168 (9000), and 5.087822 nats / 0.127713 BPB (10000) before best_s1_model (step 6250) is restored into the serialized .sh4z.
